purpose: Choose the smallest evidence-grounded path that moves one audience from its current state to the requested conversion without assigning the same persuasion job to multiple touchpoints unnecessarily.

fitSignals: high intent, retargeting, or existing category understanding
the source message already completes the needed reframe or education
proof, commercial terms, or action is the main remaining barrier
an extra destination would mainly add friction
riskSignals: the visitor does not yet recognize the problem
the visitor's cause or solution model must change before the offer makes sense

fitSignals: weak problem recognition or a materially wrong cause model
the offer is hard to value before reframing or education
the source creative cannot carry the required explanation without overload
a later direct service destination can own proof, offer, and capture after the article changes the reader's frame
riskSignals: the source creative already completes the same education
the article repeats the direct page and adds an avoidable exit point
the article collapses reframe and education together with service proof, offer, or capture instead of handing off to a later direct destination

fitSignals: the visitor cannot reliably identify which problem pattern applies
the recommended next action changes materially by answer
answering the questions itself advances understanding
the result logic and next action can be explained
riskSignals: there is no evidence-grounded diagnostic logic
all answers lead to the same sales result
question burden exceeds the value of the result
personal-data collection is the real purpose

hardGuards: Do not invent an audience, offer, customer voice, result, number, permission, or diagnostic logic.
Do not call a route optimal or best-selling before it is tested.
Do not select a channel from demographics, industry, price, or platform convention alone.
Do not present sponsored content as neutral third-party editorial.
Do not overwrite an approved strategy or a user-selected route silently.
Do not access paid project context in free_light mode.
Do not select diagnostic as the primary build target until every outcome is bound to a visible result, next action, and destination in the structure contract.
Do not present diagnostic as the recommended route until that same result and destination binding exists.

When article_reframe is selected, build the article as a reframe-and-education touchpoint only: identify may be included, but prove, offer, and capture must be assigned to a later final direct_capture Service LP whose surface_kind is destination.

For article_reframe, bind the article CTA to the next destination: set exit_action_kind to next_destination and exit_target_touchpoint_id to the final Service LP touchpoint, allow only a whole-label informational handoff to content, service details, a guide, cases or examples, a method or process, or how it works, and bind every other action through conversion_action on that final direct_capture destination.
Do not persist the brief, raw input, output, telemetry, or demand signals during the normal read-only-by-default workflow.
Treat comparison, case, demo, and offer as persuasion or proof modules rather than mutually exclusive page formats.
